headline: Mozambique Invites Russian Investors to Explore Business Opportunities
summary: Mozambican President Daniel Chapo invited Russian companies and investors to explore business opportunities in mechanized agriculture, industry, energy, infrastructure, and the blue economy.
why: Mozambique is actively seeking foreign direct investment to develop its natural resources and industrial infrastructure sectors.

impacts.name: Mozambique
impacts.why: Bilateral investment invitations aim to spur foreign capital inflows.
